goal: After lighten-pi-context completes, rebuild pi-hud as a compact optional widget using native Pi state and the lightweight context adapter.
plan: Do not start this workflow until lighten-pi-context is complete. Keep Pi native footer authoritative and remove duplicate runtime services.

tasks.title: Define the minimum useful HUD surface
acceptance: Scope is one optional widget showing model, context pressure, Git summary, and activity
Modal, work timer, event history, and custom footer replacement are excluded
Dependency on completed lighten-pi-context is confirmed before work starts
The surface remains legible, keyboard-neutral, and usable without color-only signals

approachReasons.accessibility-ux: The minimum information hierarchy and terminal presentation must remain legible and non-disruptive.

tasks.title: Build a pure width-safe widget renderer
acceptance: Every rendered line respects terminal width
JSON and print modes make no UI calls

approachReasons.tdd: Width boundaries and non-UI modes are readily testable.
approachReasons.accessibility-ux: Width safety and concise presentation directly affect terminal usability.

tasks.title: Wire bounded native-state refresh
acceptance: Widget uses native Pi state and the lightweight context adapter
No independent Git polling service exists

approachReasons.tdd: Refresh behavior and state transitions need deterministic tests.
approachReasons.performance: Refresh frequency and work must remain bounded.

tasks.title: Remove footer replacement and redundant services
acceptance: Pi native footer is not replaced
Custom modal, work timer, event history, and independent Git polling are absent

approachReasons.migration: Legacy UI and service paths must be retired without leaving duplicate ownership.
approachReasons.performance: Removing redundant services reduces background work.

tasks.title: Qualify modes, cleanup, and responsiveness
acceptance: HUD and context adapter tests pass
JSON and print modes perform no UI calls
All lines remain width-safe and widget refresh remains responsive

approachReasons.tdd: Mode behavior and cleanup invariants require regression coverage.
approachReasons.performance: Qualification must cover bounded refresh and responsiveness.
approachReasons.accessibility-ux: All terminal widths and display modes must remain usable.
